title: Algebraic characterizations of paired operators on model spaces
summary: We study paired multiplication operators associated with orthogonal decompositions of $L^2(\mathbb{T})$ arising from Hardy spaces and Sz.-Nagy--Foias model spaces. For a non-constant inner function $θ$, we characterize $\mathcal{K}_θ$-paired and triply paired operators by finite-rank commutator identities with the bilateral shift $M_z$. We also apply these ideas to sums of truncated Toeplitz and truncated Hankel operators on $\mathcal{K}_θ$.
